license_required.quote: It is a Class 2 misdemeanor for any person to advertise or practice podiatric medicine without first obtaining from the Board of Podiatry Examiners a license and an annual license renewal.

issuing_authority.quote: obtaining from the Board of Podiatry Examiners a license and an annual license renewal

age_minimum.quote: Is at least eighteen years of age and of good moral character

moral_character_required.quote: Is at least eighteen years of age and of good moral character

degree_required.quote: Possesses a doctor of podiatric medicine degree from a recognized school of podiatry approved by the board and has obtained the degree of doctor of podiatric medicine

accrediting_body.quote: a recognized school of podiatry approved by the board

required.quote: Successfully completed a one-year residency or preceptorship approved by the Council of Podiatric Medical Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association.

duration.quote: Successfully completed a one-year residency or preceptorship

kind.quote: Successfully completed a one-year residency or preceptorship approved by the Council of Podiatric Medical Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association

exams.name: National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners national standardized examination parts I, II, and III
exams.notes: Part III may be waived if applicant graduated before January 1, 2001, is currently licensed in another state, and has been in active licensed practice for at least five continuous years.
exams.quote: Has passed the National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners' national standardized examination parts I, II, and III

interval_years.quote: Each license renewal shall remain in full force and effect for one year, unless a different time is fixed by rule

required.quote: Every two years each person licensed to practice podiatry in this state shall provide the Board of Podiatry Examiners evidence that the person has attended or participated in continuing education in podiatry and related subjects

period_years.quote: Every two years each person licensed to practice podiatry in this state shall provide the Board of Podiatry Examiners evidence that the person has attended or participated in continuing education

available.quote: The board may issue a license to podiatrists of other states maintaining requirements for the practice of podiatry equal to the standard provided by this chapter.

requirements.value: Other state must maintain requirements for the practice of podiatry equal to the standard provided by South Dakota law; application fee not to exceed five hundred dollars.
requirements.quote: The board may issue a license to podiatrists of other states maintaining requirements for the practice of podiatry equal to the standard provided by this chapter.

definition_quote.value: Podiatric medicine is that profession of the health sciences concerned with the diagnosis and treatment of conditions affecting the human foot and their governing and related structures, and the soft tissues inserting into the foot, including the local manifestations of systemic conditions, by all appropriate systems and means.

drug_authority.value: Podiatrists may prescribe and dispense remedial agents within the scope of podiatric practice; unprofessional conduct includes prescribing secret remedial agents.
drug_authority.quote: To prescribe, dispense, or pretend to use, in treating any patient, any secret remedial agent
